scope.description: Every bullet in every official Dominions 6 update announcement from 6.01 through 6.36, classified and mapped without reproducing the announcements.

evidence_key.official-source-with-derived-classificat: The source bullet is official; classification, domains, materiality, terms, and canonical links are editorial derivations.

classification_key.presentation: Graphics, audio, text, or presentation change
